token_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username='siwhit@gmail.com', password='%o@8@lT')
access_token = token_resp['access_token']
resp = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3041, access_token=access_token)
content = resp['content']
old = '[x] Taking a solo backpacking trip'
new = '[ ] Taking a solo backpacking trip'
count = content.count(old)
print('old_count', count)
new_content = content.replace(old, new)
print('new_contains_new', new in new_content)
print('new_contains_old', old in new_content)

update_resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=3041, access_token=access_token, content=new_content)
print('update_resp', update_resp)

verify = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3041, access_token=access_token)
print('verify_old_count', verify['content'].count(old))
print('verify_new_count', verify['content'].count(new))
